svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Length: probe depth plus 0.5 m below it and 0.11 m above the casing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top; in 3 m lengths joined with solvent-weld couplings. Joints

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: must be smooth inside so the probe cannot catch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom 0.5 m: 10 rings of 8 mm holes, rings 50 apart, the first

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 up from the end. Each ring is two holes drilled straight through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at right angles (four holes); turn the next ring 45 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill in a V-block; deburr inside with a round file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solvent-weld the slip cap on the bottom end; drill one 8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drain hole in the cap so water can leave when the tube is lifted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top end: cut square 110 mm above the casing top; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The probe hangs 50 mm above the end, inside the drilled zone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 22 mm rod drops through the whole tube freely.
